01 / Personal

Guidance stays explainable.

Calculated baseline, contextual adjustments, and the selected daily goal remain separate. Body metrics, activity, and bounded weather assistance never silently replace the user-controlled goal.

02 / Pacing

Built around waking hours.

Optional wake and sleep schedules support daytime, overnight, and shift-work pacing without aggressive catch-up drinking or changes to the permanent goal.

03 / Inclusive

Designed for every profile.

Male, female, intersex, neutral, Pride, and challenge-specific artwork route intentionally while hydration recommendations remain independent from visual presentation.

04 / Reminders and permissions

Local, contextual, recoverable.

Android reminder delivery is physically verified and iOS reminders are first-class. Permission requests occur after relevant user action; denial leaves Hydrion usable. Expired, duplicate, failed, and orphaned notifications receive explicit handling.

  • Restart recovery
  • Exact or approximate scheduling
  • Sleep-aware suggestions
  • Stable notification identities

05 / Challenges

Participation is always explicit.

Up to two challenges can be active without silent replacement. Pause, resume, leave, complete, archive, repeat, and history behavior are supported. Bottle Bingo is deterministic; Pomodoro Sip uses timestamp-authoritative sessions; Temperature Roulette can explain weather-informed drink guidance.

  • Bottle Bingo evidence
  • Pomodoro lifecycle
  • Temperature context
  • Canonical hydration history

06 / Widgets and privacy

Useful at a glance. Private by design.

Android widgets and the iOS WidgetKit extension share canonical hydration state while excluding body measurements, reproductive state, clinician information, location, and raw schedules.

iOS WidgetKit

Small and medium families, App Group communication, stale states, accessibility, deep links, embedding and entitlement validation.

Android widgets

Daily progress and quick log use the same source of truth as the app with restricted routes and privacy-scoped snapshots.

Local deletion

Profile, history, goals, metrics, challenges, reminders, weather cache, pacing configuration, and associated application state can be deleted locally.

07 / Interface and language

Responsive by measurement.

Cards measure content; actions remain reachable across compact phones, tablets, landscape, keyboards, cutouts, navigation modes, increased text, and reduced motion.

LanguagesEnglish / French / Spanish
WeatherOptional, bounded, user-reviewed
AccountsNot required
StorageLocal-first

08 / Release engineering

One quality gate across platforms.

The final main CI gate completed successfully across Android, iOS, Web, analysis, tests, and audits.

602Flutter tests passed0test failures

Secret hygiene, formatting, static analysis, dependency state, responsive and accessibility coverage, permissions, reminders, weather, challenges, persistence, Android signatures, artifact metadata, WidgetKit embedding, version alignment, App Groups, simulator compilation, unsigned iOS release compilation, and Git hygiene were validated.

09 / Testing focus

Report device reality.

Include device model, operating-system version, Hydrion version, fresh-or-upgrade status, reproduction steps, and screenshots or recording. Pay attention to reminders after closure or restart, permission changes, Pomodoro lifecycle, challenge synchronization, profile deletion, large fonts, navigation insets, widgets, restart, and upgrade persistence.

Known limits

  • Weather requires connectivity and usable location access.
  • Android delivery varies with battery restrictions and alarm policy.
  • No cloud backup or cross-device synchronization.
  • Signed iOS distribution and final physical-iPhone validation remain separate.
  • Native widget behavior varies by launcher or host.

Health notice: Hydrion supports hydration routines but does not determine whether drinking water is safe and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Clinician-directed targets and fluid restrictions remain authoritative.
